paragraphs: Yehoshua ben Kafotai (כפותאי), Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law — Shabbat 147a.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: This notice spells the name כפותאי (Kafotai). The William Davidson vocalized text of Shabbat 147a has כפוסאי (Kefosai) and explicitly calls him Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law; the forms are not harmonized.

The fresh Davidson Shabbat147a scalar has untitled Yehoshua ben Kefosai (כפוסאי), Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law. Hyman’s כפותאי is retained as Kafotai rather than harmonized to כפוסאי or the older Kapposai.

The named scalar supports the 147a locator and explicit Rabbi Akiva; this replaces the older unresolved a? and unverified title/relationship qualifications for that digital passage only. Hyman’s doubled full stop remains intact, without a claim about its origin or printed correction history.
